replace:
<link rel="manifest" href="/site.webmanifest" />
    <!-- Link previews: replace the copy; add og:image as an absolute URL to a 1200 x 630 image. -->
    <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
    <meta property="og:title" content="Acme: a landing page people understand" />
    <meta
      property="og:description"
      content="Acme turns a one-line idea into a fast, accessible landing page that ranks and converts."
    />
    <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary" />

find: content="A React 19 + Vite app: replace this with one sentence on what the app does for its users."
replace: content="Acme turns a one-line idea into a fast, accessible landing page that ranks and converts."

find: command: `pnpm build:mock --outDir dist-e2e && pnpm preview --outDir dist-e2e --port ${port} --strictPort`,
replace:
// A landing page has no API to mock: e2e tests the production build.
        command: `pnpm build --outDir dist-e2e && pnpm preview --outDir dist-e2e --port ${port} --strictPort`,

find:
# The mocked API: a new app has no backend yet. Once it has one, set VITE_API_URL and switch to
  # `pnpm build` (here and in CI).
  command = "pnpm build:mock"
replace:
# A landing page has no API to mock.
  command = "pnpm build"
// A landing page builds without mocks, so it starts no MSW and logs no warning about it.

find: # Builds on mocks into dist-e2e/ and serves it with `vite preview`
replace: # Builds into dist-e2e/ (a landing page has no mocks) and serves it with `vite preview`
